name: Cup Custard
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Beat the eggs and the sugar and milk, and any extract or flavoring you like.
Fill your custard cups, sift a little nutmeg or cinnamon over the tops.
Set them in a moderate oven in a shallow pan half filled with hot water.
In about twenty minutes try them with the handle of a teaspoon to see if they are firm.
Serve cold with fresh fruit sugared and placed on top of each. Strawberries, peaches or raspberries, as preferred.

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat the eggs and the sugar and milk, and any extract or flavoring you like.
2. Fill your custard cups, sift a little nutmeg or cinnamon over the tops.
3. Set them in a moderate oven in a shallow pan half filled with hot water.
4. In about twenty minutes try them with the handle of a teaspoon to see if they are firm.
5. Serve cold with fresh fruit sugared and placed on top of each. Strawberries, peaches or raspberries, as preferred.
